note: The launcher (TDXLPP) imports these PUBLISHED store artifacts verbatim and keeps a byte-identical copy of each at launcher_copy; scripts/check_launcher_mirror.py compares every copy to this record and is run from either repo before a release. The store artifact is the mirror target, never a PI-Release build: a PI-Release build of the same Pkgversion is a DIFFERENT byte stream (tox export is not reproducible), and the launcher must carry the same bytes a store install gets so two copies of one version never disagree. To bump a mirrored registry: publish a release, then the launcher re-fetches by url and verifies sha256, and this record is rewritten to the published entry.
